plan_name: Digit Health Insurance Policy (I Feel Good)
sum_insured_options: Up to ₹3 Crores (plan-dependent; BharatX up to ₹3 Cr)

room_rent.note: Base plans (Double Wallet, Infinity Wallet, Worldwide, BharatX default) have no room rent restriction. Optional Cover 21 allows modification to shared/single private/1% of SI etc. for a premium reduction.

icu.note: ICU has no restriction in base plans. Optional Cover 21 room rent modification does not apply proportionate deductions to ICU charges.

copayment.display: None (base); zone co-pay 10% if hospitalized in higher zone without proof
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base plan. Zone-based 10% co-pay applies if insured hospitalizes in a higher zone without address proof. Optional Cover 2 (Network Hospital Discount) introduces 15–20% co-pay for non-PPN hospitals. Optional Cover 15 (OPD) has 25% co-pay in year 1.

sub_limits.note: Modern/new-age treatments capped at 50% of SI (waivable via Optional Cover 6 Advance Care). Cochlear implant capped at 50% of SI. Hyaluronic acid/intra-articular injections capped at 5% of SI. Road ambulance capped per policy schedule. Smart Save (Optional Cover 17) adds sub-limits on cataract, knee replacement, hernia, CABG, angioplasty etc. if opted.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible in base plan.

initial_waiting.note: Most plans: 30 days. Double Wallet, Infinity Wallet, Worldwide, Carry Forward, BharatX (select): 7 days. Early Start Plan: 30 days. Reducible via Optional Cover 3.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (12 mo on Early Start Plan)
ped_waiting.note: Standard plans: 36 months. Early Start Plan: 12 months. Reducible via Optional Cover 3 or Optional Cover 18 (Fast Track) for listed PEDs.

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (12 mo on Early Start Plan)
specific_disease_waiting.note: Standard plans: 24 months. Early Start Plan: 12 months. Reducible via Optional Cover 3.

maternity.note: Section 4 Maternity Benefit Wallet: 9-month waiting period, SI starts at ₹15,000 in year 1, increases ₹10,000/year (no claim) up to ₹1,00,000. Limited to 2 childbirth events. Pre/post-natal not covered under Section 4. Optional Cover 9 offers enhanced maternity with configurable SI and optional pre/post-natal hospitalisation. Only one of Section 4 or OC 9 can be opted.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (varies by plan; up to 600%+ via Infinite CB add-on)
cumulative_bonus.note: Base plans: 10% per claim-free year up to 100% (Double Wallet, Infinity Wallet, Worldwide, Early Start, Senior Priority, Even Protect). BharatX offers multiple CB tiers up to 600%+. Optional Cover 20 (Infinite Cumulative Bonus) adds 100% of base SI per claim-free year with no upper cap. Optional Cover 19 protects CB from reducing on a claim.

restoration.display: Once/year 100% (related & unrelated on select plans; unlimited on Infinity/Carry Forward)
restoration.note: Double Wallet & most plans: once per policy period, 100% SI, for related and unrelated illness. Infinity Wallet & Carry Forward plans: unlimited reinstatement per policy period for related and unrelated illness. BharatX: once per policy period (related) or unlimited (unrelated) depending on sub-plan chosen.

pre_hosp.note: Double Wallet: 30 days; Infinity Wallet: 60 days; Worldwide: 60 days; Early Start: 30 days; Senior Priority: 60 days; Even Protect: 30 days; BharatX: 30/60/90/120 days depending on option. Pre-hosp days always less than post-hosp days.

post_hosp.note: Double Wallet: 60 days; Infinity Wallet: 180 days; Worldwide: 180 days; Early Start: 90 days; Senior Priority: 60 days; Even Protect: 60 days; BharatX: 60/90/120/180 days depending on option.

day_care.note: Day care procedures covered under Section 1.2 for treatments requiring less than 24 hrs due to technological advancement. OPD not included.

domiciliary.note: Section 1.9 covers home hospitalisation if patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available, for minimum 3 continuous days. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, gout, diarrhoea, pyrexia of unknown origin, and several others.

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (NABH/NQAS accredited hospitals only)
ayush.note: Section 1.10 covers AYUSH in-patient treatment (Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) up to sum insured, subject to NABH/NQAS accreditation of the AYUSH hospital.

organ_donor.note: Section 2 covers organ harvesting expenses subject to specific waiting period and Transplantation of Human Organs Act compliance. Donor pre/post-hosp covered up to 5% of harvesting claim amount.

ambulance.display: Up to policy schedule limit (road); air ambulance inbuilt on select plans
ambulance.note: Road ambulance: 1% of SI max up to ₹10,000–₹15,000 per policy year (plan-dependent). Emergency Air Ambulance (Section 3) inbuilt on Infinity Wallet, Worldwide, Carry Forward, BharatX plans; not available on Double Wallet, Early Start, Senior Priority, Even Protect base plans. Optional Cover 8 (Advance Heart Ambulance) available separately.

modern_treatments.display: Sub-limited to 50% of SI (upgradeable to 100% via add-on)
modern_treatments.note: Section 35 caps robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stereotactic radiosurgery, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, intravitreal injections, bronchial thermoplasty, IONM, stem cell therapy etc. at 50% of SI. Optional Cover 6 (Advance Care) removes this cap and covers up to 100% of SI.

consumables.note: Optional Cover 1 (Consumables Cover) covers non-medical/consumable expenses listed in Annexure B up to a % of SI. Not covered in base plan.

global_cover.display: Inbuilt on Worldwide plan; not available on other base plans
global_cover.note: Section 5 (Worldwide Coverage) is inbuilt only on the 'Worldwide Treatment Plan'. Covers in-patient hospitalisation and day care outside India (diagnosis must be made in India). Claims on reimbursement basis; payments in INR. Not available on Double Wallet, Infinity Wallet, Carry Forward, Early Start, Senior Priority, Even Protect base plans.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for all modes except monthly premium payment where it is 15 days.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability permitted as per IRDAI norms with transfer of waiting period credits, NCB, and moratorium period.

notable_exclusions.display: Consumables (base), refractive error <7.5D, hormone replacement therapy, tobacco-related oral/respiratory cancer, artificial life maintenance, external congenital anomaly, non-medical expenses (base)

optional_riders.display: Consumables, OPD benefit, Infertility treatment, Infinite CB, CB protection, Room rent modification, NRI benefit, Medical equipment, Smart Save (sub-limits for discount), Fast Track (PED cover from day 30/1), Advance Care (modern tx to 100% SI)
